transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?

Thank you. Well, I came in because... honestly, most days I just feel like I’m sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. It’s just this really heavy, hopeless feeling. Even when I’m around people I know, I just can’t seem to shake it off.
About how long have you been feeling this way?

It's been... about a year and two months now. Ever since I had a fall at work. I do HVAC repair, and the fall left me with a back injury. After that happened, it just seemed like everything started unraveling.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, definitely. I used to love doing a lot of different things... hiking, painting, or just tinkering around at the makerspace. Honestly, I even used to really enjoy figuring out a tricky install on the job. 

But now... I just don't care. I'll just sit there and stare at my supplies, or I'll ignore calls from people wanting to do something, because... well, none of it even feels worth starting anymore.
Have you ever had periods where you felt the complete opposite—unusually energetic, hyper, or needing very little sleep?

No, not at all. I mean... before I got hurt, I had a normal amount of energy to get through my day, sure. But I've never been hyper or felt like I didn't need sleep. I've never experienced anything like what you're describing.
Before your work injury, had you ever experienced a time in your life where you felt this down or depressed?

No, never. I mean, I've had bad days or stressful weeks before, just like anyone else. But I've never felt anything like this... this heavy. Before the fall, I was pretty much fine, just going to work and living my life. This is the first time I've ever felt this down.
How has your sleep been since all of this started?

My sleep is pretty messed up, honestly. It's kind of one extreme or the other. Sometimes I'll just lie awake for hours... my back will be hurting from the injury, and I just can't stop thinking about all the bills piling up. But then other times, I'll end up sleeping for half the day. And even when I do sleep that long, I still wake up feeling completely exhausted, like I didn't get any rest at all.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight since this started?

Yeah, my eating is pretty much all over the place right now. I'll usually go most of the day just running on coffee, honestly, because the thought of food just turns my stomach. But then late at night, I'll end up just picking at whatever's in the cabinet. I don't even really taste it, I just kind of eat it without thinking.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?

Yeah, honestly, I have. I've... I've been having these thoughts lately that maybe everyone would just be better off if I didn't wake up. And sometimes, especially when the physical pain is really bad and the money worries just keep piling up... I actually catch myself thinking about just ending it. It really scares me that my mind even goes there, but... yeah, those thoughts are there.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with persistent depressed mood, marked anhedonia, sleep disturbances, fatigue, appetite disruption, and active suicidal ideation lasting approximately 14 months following a work injury. There is no prior history of depressive episodes, nor any history of hypomanic or manic episodes, confirming a diagnosis of a single depressive episode (ICD-10 F32).

Marked loss of interest and pleasure in hobbies, social activities, and work (anhedonia)

Appetite irregularity and reduced interest in food during the day
Recurrent passive death wishes and active suicidal ideation
